evidence_quotes: Vergunning op grond van de Waterwet.
Eisers zijn geen belanghebbende omdat zij ter plaatse van hun perceel geen gevolgen van enige betekenis ondervinden.
rationale: The Dutch District Court Midden-Nederland (RBMNE) decision explicitly concerns a permit granted pursuant to the Dutch Water Act ('Vergunning op grond van de Waterwet'), where the claimants were held not to be interested parties ('belanghebbende') due to lacking consequences of any significance at their parcel. Under the coding protocol, an explicit Waterwet permit dispute is substantively WATER under both labels and falls squarely within regulatory_permit, without involving household water/sanitation connection refusal or informal settlement access.
